The '''Mk III Flak Vest''' was a light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufactured by [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It consisted of light [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plates designed to protect its owner against shrapnel from [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="DC" />
